csharpDecision: EmitExpressionCore calls EmitStackLifetimeEndsAfter on the complete source FlowExpression, after its terminal fold result. The SLG fold control IR can retain its child AST while the source flow wrapper is elided.
existingAuthority: sollang.compiler.ir.typed.sourceExpressionValueIndex, already used by source lowering and completed interpolation selection
decision: Resolve FlowExpression unit completion to the common canonical source-result IR anchor within its concrete function. Apply that same anchor even when a wrapper remains, preventing duplicate ends. Keep exact source identity for other unit kinds; do not close at an upstream operand or callback leaf.
costChoice: Reuse existing source-value resolver after a cheap source-ancestor filter. No new frame/table schema or parallel cache.
